timelineEvents.title: San Francisco success and Three Smart Girls
timelineEvents.label: 1936 · San Francisco and Three Smart Girls
timelineEvents.shortDescription: The title song from San Francisco becomes a major hit, while Kaper and Jurmann also contribute to Universal’s Three Smart Girls.
timelineEvents.longDescription: The success of San Francisco made Kaper and Jurmann more visible in Hollywood and helped establish Kaper’s reputation beyond the MGM studio system. The event also includes Three Smart Girls, the Universal production associated with Deanna Durbin and Joseph Pasternak.
